486:t_008:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then I'll blow the whole thing away!」

486:t_008:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! Let's start with the ones coming at us!」

486:t_008:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hang on, $$正太郎$$! We'll get $$鉄人$$ back in no time!」

486:t_008:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We aren't going to lose to Angels we've already beaten once!」

486:t_008:14.en:
$$マリ$$
(Heh... You're acting a little like your old self, Princess. Nya~)

486:t_008:15.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「First, we shall strike the Angels on the front line.」

486:t_008:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's go, everyone! We will be a light that never loses to darkness!」

486:t_008:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! We will drive away the darkness!」

486:t_009:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We beat all the Angels, but...」

486:t_009:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Is there... any way for us to get out of this place...?」

486:t_009:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Think about that later! They're coming again!」

486:t_010:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you've shown up, you evil bastards!」

486:t_010:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We've defeated all your trump cards! Be good sports and admit you've lost!」

486:t_010:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We've defeated all your trump cards! Be good sports and admit you've lost!」

486:t_010:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We've defeated all your trump cards! Be good sports and admit you've lost!」

486:t_010:5.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This world of darkness is the source of our dark power.」

486:t_011:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The Angels have come back again?!」

486:t_012:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Another $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ showed up?!」

486:t_012:2.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am... $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 8...」

486:t_012:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The one we fought in $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$...!」

486:t_012:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「You are in my final memories... That Earthling boy.」

486:t_012:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Of course! I'll keep fighting to protect Earth from villains like you!」

486:t_012:10.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Have you still not realized that is a mistake...?」

486:t_012:11.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Humans are foolish and ugly... You could call them the most evil creatures in this universe.」

486:t_012:13.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Hehehe... You desperately deny it, but your heart is full of doubt.」

486:t_012:14.en:
$$ズール$$
「That computer is correct. Darkness lurks in human hearts.」

486:t_012:15.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「For their own desires, they hate others, trample them, and curse them...」

486:t_012:16.en:
$$ズール$$
「That becomes darkness and brings death to the world. That is the very source of our power.」

486:t_013:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You bastard! What the hell are you doing here?!」

486:t_013:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I came to witness your last moments.」

486:t_013:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Shut up! I don't plan on letting you see anything like that!」

486:t_013:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Stop barking, winged dog. What can you do in this world of darkness?」

486:t_013:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If it's pitch-black here, I'll light it up!」

486:t_013:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$アクエリオン$$ should be able to do it!」

486:t_013:9.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Of course! $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ is the Solar Wings!」

486:t_013:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ソーラーアクエリオン$$'s light gave us strength during the $$時獄戦役$$, too!」

486:t_013:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Just watch, $$ミカゲ$$! I'll show you my power!!」

486:t_014:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A winged dog's reincarnation cannot do it. That is how deep this darkness is.」

486:t_014:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If you give up now, you'll be playing right into his hands!」

486:t_014:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's right, $$アポロ$$! $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$'s light really did save us then!」

486:t_014:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...Heh... It's a strange feeling, being encouraged by my own reincarnation.」

486:t_014:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Then get on with it! Turning the tables when it counts is $$アクエリオン$$'s specialty!」

486:t_015:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Stay out of this, old man $$不動$$!」

486:t_015:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Call him Supreme Commander, $$アポロ$$! He may be the reincarnation of someone you knew, but he is a different person!」

486:t_015:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Old man $$不動$$ is old man $$不動$$! What's wrong with calling him that?!」

486:t_015:6.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Supreme Commander... What did you mean by 'futile'?」

486:t_015:7.en:
$$不動$$
「$$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ shone with the sun's radiance in the $$時獄戦役$$ because it had gathered people's feelings for 12,000 years.」

486:t_015:8.en:
$$アンディ$$
「So the current $$ソーラー$$ is out of energy?!」
